detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-10-21 Linux 7.4 quietly euthanizes the ancient UnixWare BFS filesystem while adding a two-byte CMPXCHG emulation path, and some old CPUs are on notice. Not glamorous, but exactly the kind of kernel housekeeping that eventually bites someone's dusty NAS. 🔗 https://www. phoronix.com/news/BFS-Removed- With-Linux-7.4 # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
